grader.scenario: Home move broadband transfer to new property; Openreach optical ONT installation booking, 4G backup mini-hub provision, and Hub 5 dispatch
grader.notes: Flawless 16-minute home move booking call. Nathan promptly reassures Eleanor regarding her court hearing connectivity concerns with an S-Net Home Move Guarantee and emergency 4G backup hub. Successfully books an Openreach morning engineer slot during a managed 70s hold, sets up a 48-hour overlap on the old line, upgrades her to a Hub 5, and confirms all reference numbers.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Opened at [00:00] with 'Thank you for calling S-Net customer services' and closed at [17:32] with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net as your home broadband provider'.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: A single 70s hold between [05:30] and [06:50] to check the Openreach exchange calendar was properly announced with 'Bear with me for about a minute' and returned with 'Thank you for waiting, Eleanor'.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Agent requested current address and security PIN at [00:29], well within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent used the customer's name Eleanor warmly and naturally throughout the call (turns 2, 4, 6, 14, 21, 43, 65, 71).

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Customer experienced high anxiety at turn 13 ([03:25]) about potential work court hearing disruptions. Agent immediately empathized at turn 14 ([03:50]): 'Moving house while managing intense court schedules is tremendously stressful, and I completely understand why any broadband delay would cause severe anxiety.'

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: At turn 6 ([01:30]), agent restated the request: 'So what you need is to transfer your Fibre 500 broadband service from 14 Oakfield Road over to your new address at 29 St Andrews Court on your move-in date, with zero interruption to your remote legal work. Have I got that right, Eleanor?'

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent did not repeat any answered questions. At turn 43 ([12:14]), confirming existing equipment before finalizing the order was a harmless verification step.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent completely owned the transfer, coordinated Openreach booking, provisioned the 4G backup device, and arranged the overlap without deflecting.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Polite and professional throughout. Turn 23 used 'As I mentioned, Openreach engineer appointment slots require adult presence' in a polite, helpful manner.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Probed for ONT box presence at the new property (turn 10), desired live date (turn 8), preferred master socket location (turn 25), and existing equipment (turn 43).

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: At turns 65-66 ([16:38]-[16:49]), agent asked if everything was covered, and Eleanor confirmed: 'Yes, everything is completely sorted and clearly booked. I have all the references and dates.'
